sources.games: 445 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 48.5%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py anti_mage.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Mjollnir, Eye of Skadi, Aghanim's Scepter.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-19: BKB only with a lot of control; Abyssal over Silver Edge; Skadi against Huskar at times.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Anti-Mages against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 12% of 43 games against them (5% otherwise), won 40% against 45% (a thin sample).

rules.name: Eye of Skadi

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} halves their health restoration, so keep it in the build
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} удвічі ріже відновлення здоров'я, тож не пропускайте його

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s (+35 all attributes, the slow). It is in his build (35%, ~28 min). The player review: Skadi against Huskar at times; it answers every heavy healer the same way.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 33% (2), magic_wand 68% (4), power_treads 100% (6), pers 62% (11), bfury 100% (14), yasha 100% (17), manta 99% (20), butterfly 57% (28), skadi 35% (28), basher 58% (28), black_king_bar 21% (32), sange 41% (33), abyssal_blade 38% (34).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 20:00 12500 (31 games, 80.6%), 25:00 17000 (50 games, 80.0%), 30:00 22500 (28 games, 82.1%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. No 85% line for this hero (two of the three minutes needed): the hero's own 80% line (scripts/hero_item_stats.py WIN_TARGETS).

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 445 games: maxed antimage_blink > antimage_mana_break > antimage_counterspell 225 (win 50.2%), antimage_mana_break > antimage_blink > antimage_counterspell 104 (win 47.1%), antimage_blink > antimage_counterspell > antimage_mana_break 92 (win 55.4%); talents 10: Mana Void Radius 264/443 (50.4%), +3 Health Regen 179/443 (45.3%); 15: Mana Void Damage Multiplier 262/354 (58.0%), / Persecutor Min/Max Movement Slow 92/354 (46.7%); 20: Blink Cast Range 169/235 (60.4%), Mana Void Stun 66/235 (54.5%); 25: Mana Void Cooldown 108/139 (60.2%), Blink Cooldown 31/139 (61.3%).

suppress.illusions: Battle Fury (100% of his won games, ~14 min) already cleaves the illusions around his target; high-rank Anti-Mage players do not add Maelstrom against illusion heroes.
suppress.break: Abyssal Blade is in his build (~34 min); the player review: Abyssal is fine against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar, and Silver Edge is not bought by high-rank Anti-Mages there.
suppress.magic: Counterspell gives 35% magic resistance and reflects targeted spells (Valve 7.41f). The player review: BKB when there is a lot of control; that is read from the match itself (two deaths under stuns or a Hex bring Black King Bar for every hero), not from 3+ magic damage heroes in the lineup.
